checks.title: Login, recovery, and step-up flows bind identity correctly
Account linking cannot merge attacker and victim identities
Object-level authorization enforced per actor and tenant
Tenant boundary holds across list, search, and export
Role changes and invitations cannot escalate privilege
Session tokens have bounded purpose and lifecycle
Logout and rotation invalidate prior tokens
Server-enforced state transitions cannot be skipped
Quantity, price, and quota invariants hold server-side
Equivalent rules across methods, versions, and protocols
Schema enforcement matches on REST, GraphQL, and RPC surfaces
User input cannot reach executable sinks unescaped
PostMessage and frame communication validate origin and shape
OAuth/OIDC callbacks bind state, nonce, and redirect
Webhooks verify signatures and reject replays
Server-side parsers treat input as data (SQL/template/command)
Expression and formula evaluation is sandboxed or absent
File upload, path, and archive handling stays bounded
Server-side fetch (SSRF) cannot reach internal targets
Exposed endpoints and debug surfaces are intended and gated
Error and version disclosure stays minimal
Cache layers isolate tenants and authenticated content
Method and header handling agrees across proxies
Sensitive data encrypted in transit and at rest with safe defaults
Error paths fail closed without oracle behavior
